title: Man. Post. Cap. III: Laudo denique — sin and death; exhort perseverance; before Cap. IV
pass_a_gloss: Finally I praise that you call this vice also a sin, and acknowledge it so called by the Apostle, and confess that it bound all men over to death; and I exhort you to persevere constantly in that doctrine which Scripture, and according to Scripture all the Churches of the Protestants by unanimous consent, teach.
pass_b_english: Finally I praise that you call this vice a sin, acknowledge the Apostle so names it, and confess it bound the whole race over to death. I urge you to hold fast to that doctrine which Scripture teaches, and which, following Scripture, all the Protestant churches teach with one consent.
source_text: Laudo denique quod hoc vitium, & peccatum appellas, & sic vocatum ab Apostolo agnoscis, & morti homines universos addixisse fateris, teque hortor ut in ea doctrina, quam Scriptura, & secundum scripturam Ecclesiae omnes protestantium unanimi consensu docent, perseveres constanter.

choices.choice: Praise sin/death naming; exhort Protestant consensus; stop before Cap. IV
choices.why: Closes Cap. III before Rursus observata

notes: Cap. III Observata quaedam densify section 212 from locked 1661 Latin (pp. 186 tip–190 tip).
